headline: New law requires the Justice Department to set national standards to prevent and punish sexual harassment and assault of federal prison staff by inmates.
what_it_does: The law requires the Department of Justice to adopt national standards for preventing, reducing, and punishing sexual harassment and sexual assault by incarcerated people against Bureau of Prisons employees, including correctional officers. It also requires the Bureau of Prisons to fully carry out the recommendations from a Justice Department Inspector General report on how the agency handles these incidents.

who_it_affects.group: Federal Bureau of Prisons employees, including correctional officers
who_it_affects.how: They are covered by new national standards meant to prevent and respond to sexual harassment and assault by inmates.
They may face punishment under the new standards if they sexually harass or assault prison staff.

who_it_affects.group: Department of Justice and Bureau of Prisons
who_it_affects.how: They must create the national standards and put the Inspector General's recommendations fully into place.

when_it_takes_effect: Enacted September 16, 2026; the summary does not give specific deadlines.
